proof_body:
by
  intro f S x y e he hx hy hd hb hu
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.1 hu e he
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hd δ hδ
  have h1 := hN N le_rfl
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h1
  have h2 := h (x N) (hx N) (y N) (hy N) (by rwa [Real.dist_eq])
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at h2
  exact absurd h2 (not_lt.2 (hb N))
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (x y : ℕ → ℝ) (e : ℝ), 0 < e → (∀ n, x n ∈ S) → (∀ n, y n ∈ S) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => x n - y n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → (∀ n, e ≤ |f (x n) - f (y n)|) → ¬ UniformContinuousOn f S
